title: Empirical Bayes prepivoting under group invariance: false discovery rate control and moderated t-tests
summary: We consider simultaneously testing hypotheses about thousands of units, e.g., genes or proteins, where each unit yields a handful of replicate measurements and we test whether its mean is zero. A widely used approach in genomics, implemented in the limma software, borrows strength across units to learn the distribution of the unit-specific variances, then computes moderated t-statistics.
